title: Kyle Shanahan: Brandon Aiyuk's reinstatement means "absolutely nothing" to 49ers

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan: Brandon Aiyuk's reinstatement means "absolutely nothing" to 49ers
sources.description: Brandon Aiyuk was reinstated from the 49ers' reserve/left squad list on Monday, but head coach Kyle Shanahan's tune has not changed about the wide receiver.
